Through firsthand accounts and on-the-ground reporting, the series brings global events closer to viewers, providing context, perspective, and a deeper understanding of the challenges people face worldwide.By showcasing personal experiences alongside broader social, political, and cultural contexts, Witness offers viewers a nuanced and compelling understanding of the forces shaping our world, making distant realities tangible and relatable.
